texts.zh:
有机全典包含了曾经居住在全星系的数千种智慧物种的详细基因数据。我们的遗传学家可以利用这些数据在我们的殖民地上复活一种已灭绝的物种。

一旦我们选择了一个殖民地，遗传学家就会仔细研究有机全典，并挑选出适合其气候的物种。
texts.en:
The Omnicodex contains detailed genetic data on thousands of sapient species that once inhabited the galaxy. Our geneticists could use that data to revive an extinct species on one of our colonies.

Once we have selected a planet, the geneticists will go through the Omnicodex and pick a species suitable to its climate.
